ImageDescription.value:
Ferdinand Fischer - Prelude and Chaconne 

This is a transcription of a clavichord record by Joan Benson (Bridge S 2250).

It was a "recommended recording of the year" (1973) by the Saturday Review. This recording is on clavichords by Thomas Goff of England and Jacobus Verwolf of the Netherlands. To appear later will be selections on historical

instruments: a 1568 Tosi, and 1796 Schiedmayer.
